assertion_analysis.failure_condition: The gate re-run receipt is returned without the landing_check key (the base behaviour), so result["landing_check"] raises KeyError; this is the negative control's observed failure.
The landing check reports a reversal set other than the single staged path created.txt, i.e. the pre-staging reversal detection has regressed or the receipt carries no reversals.

The reported reversal commit differs from first_commit, which the test reads independently via _head(repository) after the first landing, so the reported commit must name the earlier landing's commit.
The reversal is not printed to stderr, i.e. _report_landing_check is not called on the gate landing result, so capsys err is empty.

0.reason: cosmetic: the gate receipt carries an empty landing_check where the release site omits the key; no reader distinguishes an empty check from an absent one, and the reviewer judged the emitted receipt unchanged in meaning

findings.text: follow-on: the gate receipt carries landing_check unconditionally, so a no-write or no-check landing emits landing_check:{} where the sibling release site (reckon/crew/promotion_release.py:643) adds the key only when the check is non-empty; the divergence is cosmetic and does not change the emitted receipt meaningfully.
